levels.text: Spin without locking your other skills

name: Mercenary Whirlwind
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Whirlwind (players/paladin/mercenary/whirlwind_merc.sval, 22 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 3 (in brackets): not blocking; no stamina cost (3). Its own mana 70, cooldown 9 s. Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: Whirlwind (50 physical for 5 s) no longer blocks your other actions while you spin, and costs no stamina.
